description: Header file defining classes and structures for pre-association steering monitoring in a Wi-Fi management system, including configuration and state management for clients and access points.

classes.name: pre_association_steering_hal_ap_config
classes.description: Configuration class for access point parameters related to inactive check intervals and thresholds.

classes.name: pre_association_steering_hal_sta_config
classes.description: Configuration class for station parameters including SNR thresholds, state, and packet statistics.

classes.name: monitor_pre_association_steering_hal
classes.description: Main class managing pre-association steering monitoring, including client and AP configurations, event processing, and state management.

methods.name: conf_add_client
methods.description: Add a new client configuration by MAC address.

methods.name: conf_get_client
methods.description: Retrieve existing client configuration by MAC address.

methods.name: conf_add_ap
methods.description: Add a new access point configuration by vap_id.

methods.name: conf_erase_ap
methods.description: Remove an access point configuration by vap_id.

methods.name: conf_erase_client
methods.description: Remove a client configuration by MAC address.
